item.title: Excellence on display at 12th Annual Black History Month Showcase
item.description: In Vallejo, Black excellence is more than history. It’s living legacies. On Thursday night, those legacies came alive through song and dance. Students from nine Vallejo schools came together at the Vallejo High School auditorium in a collaborative showcase of Black pride. item.title: NorthBay team answers call to serve
item.description: NorthBay Health podiatrist Keven Miller still has a hard time not choking up as he shares the stories from a medical mission trip to the Philippines that he and eight other NorthBay healthcare providers made last month.
